concerns.text: T004's stated JSON schema (flat top-level keys, nested 'eigenvalues' list, no 'timestamp'/'support_density') contradicts the SimulationRun/EigenvalueResult contracts it claims to conform to; both contracts set additionalProperties:false, so the file cannot satisfy both. The implementer cannot deterministically produce a conforming artifact — reconcile the schema with the contracts.

T005 sweeps N ∈ {100,500,1000,2000} × seeds {42,123,456,789} 'consuming checksummed raw matrices', but no task in this document generates or checksums raw matrices for any (N, seed) combination other than matrix_N1000_seed42.npy (T003). 15 of 16 input combinations are unreachable as specified — add a generation/checksum step or point the sweep at on-the-fly seeded generation.

T007's verification requires outlier probability crossing '<10% to >90%', but with 4 seeds per configuration the probability is quantized to {0,25,50,75,100}%; the criterion degenerates to a 0%→100% jump and may be unsatisfiable for a gradual transition, making theta_c_empirical unidentifiable and the task's own verification unpassable. Also the grid starts at θ=1.5 while θ_c=1, so the crossing may not be bracketed at all.

T010's input 'data/configs/density_grid.json' with 'fixed θ grid spanning the transition region' is never defined — no θ values, no file contents, no producing task. The implementer cannot execute or verify 'row count equals the density-grid product' against an unspecified grid.

T011 estimates θ_c per (N, density) by pooling seeds (T007's method) yet requires 'std_dev (std across seeds)' — a pooled per-group estimate yields no per-seed values, so the specified column is not computable as written. Specify per-seed estimation or drop/redefine the std_dev column.

T009 fills AggregatedThreshold's per-(N,k,pattern,θ)-row fields theta_c_estimate/theta_c_confidence from T007/T008 fits that are produced per (N,k,pattern) group — the grouping granularity doesn't match the row granularity, so the implementer cannot deterministically populate these columns. State how group-level estimates map to rows (constant per group, or re-fit per θ).

T001 and T002 are too coarse for deterministic execution: T001 bundles layout verification, dependency pinning, quickstart documentation, and domain validation; T002 bundles three modules plus three test files plus input validation. Split so each task has a single verifiable deliverable (the downstream atomizer will handle this if flagged).

T013 requires research.md to 'quote actual numeric values' from artifacts; per Constitution Principle IV these must be re-derived at the paper stage, not hand-copied — add a note so the paper-stage handoff (T014) flags this.
